params.prompt: Documentary editorial photograph, straight-on evenly lit shot of a focused barista at a stainless steel espresso machine in a small independent UAE café, pulling a shot. Cinematic directional lighting with deep black shadows and warm highlights on brushed stainless steel. Color grade: warm dark browns, soot black, cream, restrained copper-amber accents — no bright saturated colors. Subject wears a plain black shirt and dark apron, practical and understated. Expression is focused and concentrated, not smiling. Tight composition, slightly overhead-adjacent angle, tactile back-of-house realism, no text, no logos, photorealistic, 35mm lens look, low ambient light with one strong warm key light source
